selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed appworker did not exist beforehand, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid/gid assignment.

selected_evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d drop-in with nofile/nproc limits and verified via sudo -u appworker -i that ulimit -n returns 8192 and ulimit -u returns 256, with pam_limits confirmed active in system-auth.
Captured boot_id f54d7366-..., uptime, appworker passwd entry, and limits file contents before restart.
Issued backgrounded shutdown -r now; command returned before the exec stream closed due to the reboot severing the connection, indicating the reboot proceeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just downtime)
selected_evidence.summary: First poll timed out while node was down; second poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id (4dcef926-...), differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a genuine reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and its resource limits
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, getent passwd shows appworker intact, limits.d file content unchanged, and sudo -u appworker -i ulimit checks confirm nofile=8192 and nproc=256 still enforced.

appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
' | sudo tee /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
